title: Irish plan offers Burnham breakthrough on Made in Europe
summary_full: Irish presidency of EU proposes giving UK ‘partner’ status on assembly of cars in possible boost to reset of relationsThe UK would not have to follow the EU and apply tariffs on Chinese car imports under an Irish proposal that could prove another breakthrough for the prime minister, Andy Burnham, in his reset of relations with the bloc.The proposal comes as the UK’s foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, told a parliamentary committee that there had been “a transformation in the EU view”.
